# Vendored front-end libraries

Served locally so QueryMind makes no requests to external hosts. Both are MIT-licensed (license headers are kept in the files).
Only the trailing `sourceMappingURL` comment lines were removed (the maps are not shipped).

| Library | Version | Source | Files |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bootstrap | 5.3.3 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist | `bootstrap/css/bootstrap.min.css`, `bootstrap/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js` |
| Bootstrap Icons | 1.11.3 | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/font | `bootstrap-icons/bootstrap-icons.min.css`, `bootstrap-icons/fonts/*` |
